about.heading: I build Front-End results, from scratch.
about.p1: I work in Front-End Development, Frontend Architecture, Design Systems, component-based construction, web performance and enterprise applications. I connect business rules, interfaces, components, APIs and performance to turn complex systems into fluid, scalable experiences.
about.p2: I've worked across operational domains — public education and tax/fiscal management — where the hard part isn't the interface, it's encoding messy business rules into systems that stay reliable when real people depend on them.
